course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A software engineer named Mr. Khabir is working in a financial technology company that provides online banking service. One day, the company's system is attacked, and customer data is leaked on the dark web. Further investigation reveals the followings:
i) An attacker used hacking techniques to access the system.
ii) Some employees are victims of phishing and identity theft.
iii) Fake news is being spread online damaging the company's reputation.
iv) The attacker may be part of a larger group involved in cyber terrorism targeting financial institutions.
The company now facès legal, ethical, and security challenges under cyber law.
